product.name: Apple 85W MagSafe 2 Charger
product.full_name: Genuine 85W MagSafe 2 Power Adapter for MacBook Pro Retina 15"
product.description: Genuine Apple power adapter (Model A1424, Apple Part No. MD506LL/A) for MacBook Pro with Retina display 15-inch (Mid 2012 to Mid 2015, A1398). Uses the thin, magnetic MagSafe 2 connector — not compatible with older MagSafe 1 (L-shaped / T-shaped) MacBooks. 20V, 4.25A, 85W output. Because it is the highest-wattage MagSafe 2 adapter, it can also safely charge the 13-inch MacBook Pro Retina (2012-2015) and MacBook Air (2012-2017) with MagSafe 2, which only draw what they need. Includes the detachable AC wall plug. Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Original Apple unit, tested before dispatch.
compatible_models: MacBook Pro Retina 13-inch (Late 2012 – Early 2015, lower-wattage compatible)
